title: Biotic Deposits
definition: Biotic deposits (pelagic oozes) are deep-sea marine sediments composed primarily of the skeletal remains and calcareous or siliceous hard parts of microscopic marine organisms (plankton).
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC Prelims under Oceanography (marine resources, floor topography, and sedimentology) and connects to climate change, ocean acidification, and paleoceanography in Mains GS-I/III.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Biotic Deposits.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basics of Ocean Relief and Continental Margins
